name: Sera
tagline: Recommends music by predicted brain-response similarity instead of what other listeners clicked.
problem: Recommendations based on others' clicks miss what music actually does to a listener.
solution: Runs tracks through a brain-response research model to get cortical fingerprints, shows them on a 3D brain mesh and recommends songs whose fingerprints are close; listeners can compare taste shapes.
demo_moment: Team-described: add a few songs, see the predicted brain response and get matches.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Built on a recently released research model.

lessons: A fresh research model can anchor a consumer idea if the visual makes it legible.
